trigger: Annex gate. The guard who never left: Tolliver.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: DIXIE VALLEY ANNEX — RESTRICTED — USE OF DEADLY FORCE AUTHORIZED. The sign has bullet holes. From the inside.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: Halt. Sir. Ma'am. This is a restricted facility. State your business and your clearance.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A man in a contractor guard uniform, ironed. Beard to his chest. Rifle clean. Eyes very far away.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Tolliver. It's Dr. Reyne. Level three. You know me. You let me out.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: Dr. Reyne. You left. Everyone left. I was told to hold the gate until relieved. I have not been relieved.

choices.text: You did your job. It's over.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: ...By whose authority? ...No. No, there's nobody left to authorize anything, is there.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: Ninety-two days. I kept a log. Would you like to see it? Nobody's seen it.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: Sir, I will defend this post.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He's fast for a man that thin. Not fast enough. He dies at his post, which is what he wanted, maybe.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: The doors are maglocked. Dead power means locked forever. You'd need a generator. A big one.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: I've got a ninety-kilowatt ground power cart on a flatbed.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: ...Well. That would do it. I'll lift the gate. Mind the lower wing. Something's been in and out of it.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: ...I'd like that. I'd like to be relieved. I'll pack the log.

nodes.speaker: amb_tolliver
nodes.text: Yes, sir. Holding the gate. It's what I'm good at.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Through the gate. A hangar, an airstrip with grey ash drifting across it. And a low concrete building with no windows.
